Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: Implement Phases 0-2 — click combat, player bars, resources

Phase 0+1: Core framework \(event bus, game state, game loop\), click combat
with damage numbers, monster spawning/death, gold/XP granting, save/load.

Phase 2: Player HP bar \(with color thresholds\), energy bar \(click gain +
regen\), XP bar, health regen system.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: Phase 3 — Progression system with level-up celebration modal

- Extract XP/level-up logic from main.js into progression.js system
- Create balance.js with centralized scaling formulas \(XP curve, HP, attack\)
- Refactor player.js to use balance.js for stat computation
- Add level-up celebration modal with staggered animations
- Milestone toasts at levels 25, 50, 75, 100
- Auto-save on level up
- DEBUG.giveXP now triggers proper level-up flow

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: Convert level-up modal to non-blocking top banner, fix DEBUG.giveXP

- Replace centered modal overlay with a top banner that slides in/out
  so players can keep clicking during the celebration
- Export grantXP from progression.js and call it directly from DEBUG
  instead of emitting combat:monsterKilled \(which triggered combat-ui
  errors when no monster existed\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
